The inn behind the wooden gate

Stingray Beach Inn sits on Ziyaarai Magu, a short walk from Maafushi's harbour and Bikini Beach. Rooms are arranged around a sandy garden shaded by palms, with hammocks for the slow hours between swims.

The inn runs its own restaurant, Stingray Cafe, in the lobby garden, and a front desk that can sort out everything from speedboat transfers to a boat for the day. It is a local island stay: real Maldivian village life outside the gate, and some of the clearest water in the atoll a few steps past it.

  • Garden with hammocks and a shared hot tub
  • Free WiFi throughout the property
  • 24-hour front desk and room service
  • Bicycles available to rent for island exploring

Rooms

Every room is individually decorated in warm tones with hand-painted floral murals on teal walls, and comes with an attached bathroom with a rain shower. Tea and coffee are on the house in the lobby, all day.

Deluxe King Room

From $63 per night

A king-size bed, individually controlled air conditioning and a ceiling fan, and space to unpack properly. Suits couples and anyone who likes a big bed after a day on the water.

Stingray Cafe Restaurant

The inn's restaurant sits in the lobby garden and serves Maldivian and international dishes through the day: fresh seafood, curries, and juices squeezed to order. Breakfast is served every morning, and in-room dining is available if you would rather eat on your own schedule.

Go out on a fishing trip and our chefs will prepare your catch for dinner. It is the house specialty, and it costs you nothing but the trip itself.

Breakfast

Days out from the inn

Maafushi is a base, not just a bed. Book any of these at the front desk or in your booking email, and we will arrange the boat, the gear and the timing.

Snorkelling at Turtle Reef

House reefs and nearby snorkel points with turtles, rays and clouds of reef fish. Gear is provided, and the boat ride out is half the fun.

Sunset dolphin cruise

An evening ride on a traditional dhoni as spinner dolphins ride the bow wave and the sky turns. The most-booked trip on the island.

Sandbanks and fishing trips

Spend a morning on a white sandbank in the middle of the lagoon, or fish the traditional way at dusk. Your catch goes straight to our kitchen.

Water sports and excursions to nearby resort and local islands can also be arranged at the front desk.

Getting here

Maafushi is about 27 km south of Velana International Airport. There is no road to an island, so the last leg is always by boat. Tell us your flight details at least 2 days before you arrive and we will have your transfer arranged; you pay for it at check-in.

1

Shared speedboat

About 35 minutes from Malé, running several times a day. The fast, easy option, and the one most guests take.

2

Public ferry

About 1.5 hours from Malé's ferry terminal. Slower and cheaper, with a proper local feel. Schedules vary by day.

3

Private charter

Travelling as a group or landing late? We can arrange a private speedboat at a time that suits your flight.

Privacy Policy

            
This website does not run accounts, tracking cookies or analytics. The only personal information we receive is what you type into the booking enquiry, which travels through your own email app to our inbox. We use your name, email address and travel dates only to answer your enquiry, arrange your stay and organise transfers you ask for. We do not sell or share your details with anyone else, and booking platforms never see enquiries made here. You can ask us at any time, by email, to delete the messages you have sent us.

          

          

            
Terms of Stay

            
Sending an enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Your reservation is confirmed only when we reply by email with your rate and availability. Rates quoted are per room per night and may vary by season; the rate in your confirmation email is the rate you pay. Airport transfers are arranged on request with at least 2 days notice and are paid at check-in. Check-in requires the main guest to be 18 or older, and pets are not allowed at the inn. If your plans change, reply to your confirmation email and we will do our best to move your dates.
